output.summary: KEP-1489 adds a vendor-specific CSI Migration path for the in-tree Cinder volume plugin, inheriting from parent KEP-625 and introducing two feature gates. The KEP reached status implemented at stage stable.
output.rationale: The in-tree Cinder plugin needed migration to CSI, so this KEP is a vendor-specific child of the parent CSI Migration KEP and defers its content to that parent. Work stayed in beta for several releases because the test plan and graduation criteria were missing and no primary maintainer was available after 2020. The code implementation PR (kubernetes#107462) was confirmed for GA in 1.24, and the status was later set to implemented.

alternatives.option: Keep the KEP in beta for 1.19 and stabilize it there
alternatives.why_not: Maintainer msau42 proposed this in 2020, but the original author stepped away and the work was handed to chrigl and ramineni, so it did not proceed on that path.
ramineni said it would not be possible for 1.20 and would target the next release.

evidence.quote: This inherits all the contents from its parent KEP. It will introduce two new feature gates to be used as as described in its parent KEP.
I am no longer working on this, @chrigl @ramineni would be primary contacts.
